body: Counter-example tested: an over-broad conflict set or unreleased grant holds the box approaches. Rejected: seed-1 G4 liveness run shows worst stale holder 0.67 s and 6401 grant ticks at the box; the stands are Dynamic heads outside every box rule instead.

Connector recovery alone does not clear G4 seed 1: both Dynamic heads (2109v0, 2021v0) stand on Lane(294)/Lane(299) at the lane end, not on a connector; recovery fails on walkers pinned at gap 0 (nobody_coming and corridor), so lifting on_lane changes nothing there.

Connector recovery only inside the lane band (!off_lane) and the Rejoin offset stepped by the lateral law on connectors, instead of the decaying connector offset. Alternative not taken: recover anywhere within lost and keep the decay (off-band kinematic bodies in a box are outside the conflict table model: G1 class; the decay never lets a recovered car become idle on its connector, so no box pass).

R1 seed 7 kinematic lock: fix connector sensing (swept body along the connector path) rather than the demotion rule. The two holders stand at IDM rest 2.00 m behind the left car seen by the straight 6 m strip while their true body sweep passes it at 0.37-0.39 m. Alternative not taken: demote holders by their sense hit (they would be re-granted, re-stopped by the same false positive).

Walker-pinned Dynamic heads (G4 s1, extra s1, rb far, (c)) need a walker-side rule; recommend pulling TASK-036 item 1 (civilians go around car bodies via tactics::around_cars on RoadOccupancy) into this task as a stage. Alternative not taken: car-side hysteresis change (a car with a walker at its nose still waits in IDM, the mutual wait stays).

Connector recovery band = conflict-table body model (half.x + conflict_margin/2, 1.35 m reach), not the lane band (left_gap/2, 1.625 m): the table only guarantees 0.3 m between co-granted sweeps, so a car recovered 0.4 m off could pass through a kinematic neighbour. Alternative not taken: PLAN.md off_lane band (wider, would also catch 0.15-0.425 m offsets, none seen in traces).

Stage 2 path sweep counts a body only if some part of it lies ahead of the car's current nose line (the TASK-016 rule of the straight strip kept). Not taken: PLAN_V2 full-body samples from travel 0, which hold a car for a body pressed at its flank and for bodies its rear swings into on a curve (connector-only TASK-016 regression).

Path sweep step = the recover.rs corridor law (0.3 m travel or 7.5 deg of path yaw, whichever is finer), shared constants, no bound claimed. Not taken: PLAN_V2 R5 law '0.3 m, r >= 1.7 m moves a corner < 0.6 m' - arithmetic gives 0.63 m at r 1.7 and the Bezier minimum radius is 0.707 x leg; TASK-038 measured 0.83-0.98 m at 0.2 m.

A Rejoin on a connector slides (heading = path tangent, no yaw swing). Not taken: keep the lateral-law swing, which at 0.10 m lateral from rest yaws 7.5 deg and reaches 1.46 m across the path, past the 1.35 m table band that stage 1's G1 argument rests on.

Walkers go around standing vehicle bodies only (RoadBody standing > 0, Footprint::Rect). Not taken: every vehicle body as the police arrest list does; steering at the corners of a moving car is new behaviour nobody asked for and can send a walker toward a moving car's front corner.

Q4 option B skin derived, no new data: rest_skin = switch.skin + lateral.rate_at_rest x switch.horizon_seconds (0.18 m), for vehicle bodies at rest only. Not taken: a data margin in traffic.ron recover (new tuning number) or applying it to walkers (a standing walker reaches walk speed within ticks and would flip-flop the car).

Flank gate re-anchored on the player pressed by set_intent with a penetration precondition. Not taken: a dummy placed touching the flank, which sits at 1.55 m across (outside the 1.5 m strip band) so the 'cast from the centre' flip cannot go RED.

Stage 0 done: baseline gates and re-trace stored; every red row matches the PLAN_FINAL cause table (A/B/C/D), so stages 1-4 proceed as planned. Alternative not taken: re-plan on a differing cause (none found).

Stage 1 done and green (gta_sim 560 passed, 0 failed; f-rows flip RED under A lane-only on_path, B no connector step, C no slide, D on_path everywhere). G4 seed 7: Dynamic stand gone, but a class-E lock remains (every exit of lane 297 blocked by the left car, box pass blocked by the oncoming queue head and crosswalk walkers); recorded in OPEN_DECISIONS, re-trace after stage 3 before any fallback. Alternative not taken: patch plan_box_pass now (would be a parallel fix before the planned stages changed the scene).

Stage 3: walkers go around standing cars via tactics::around_cars; two latent around_cars faults found by the new gate/trace and fixed in the rule itself: a corner whose line only the walker's centre clears (grazes the car: 2.95 s pinned) and a corner the walker already stands on (re-picked forever when the target lies diagonally past the car: G4 seed 1 walker 2049v0 stuck 75 s). Alternative not taken: a commit/hysteresis state per walker (new mechanism, parallel to the rule).

Stage 3 flank gate re-anchored on the player with a contact precondition (|across| < half.x + r + 0.01): the pressed capsule sinks only 0.003 m, never 0.02 m inside the band; the sabotage is the plan's fallback (cast from the centre, half width + capsule radius, gap minus half length) and goes RED (moved 0.00 m). Alternative not taken: the 0.02 m penetration precondition (GATE BROKEN on every run).

Stage 4.1 (Q3) R1 fixture: placing the left car only when no body centre is within 6.08 m of the hub changed nothing (hub free at placement; the granted car driving through the box at 2.8 m/s is still switched 1.4 m later); also requiring no grant at the node was never satisfiable within 5 s (GATE BROKEN in all box_scene rows). Both reverted; class D in R1 seed 1 left to the fallback decision.

Class E (every exit of an approach crosses the left car, no box pass fits) recorded for the orchestrator instead of building the U-turn fallback: no patch of the class has been tried, repick (the re-route) already runs and finds no exit, and a U-turn needs new graph connectors kept out of the random exit choice. G4 seed 7 liveness, the extra row and R1 seeds 1/7 stay ignored with class-named reasons; G4 seed 1 liveness un-ignored; (c)/rb assert the city-wide Dynamic bound. Alternative not taken: build U-turn connectors now (new mechanism without a decision).

Q4 option B built for class D after the Linux (c) re-run showed it (2088v0 on Lane(462) held 88 s inside recover.skin of a given-up car at rest, 0.28 m). The plan's fixed rest skin (0.18 m) failed an existing gate (e_blocked_corridor re-switched: the lane rejoin's yaw swing moves corners farther than rate_at_rest x horizon); rebuilt as the per-car derived skin switch.skin + the rejoin's own excursion (offset + corner arc of turn and heading swing), capped at recover.skin. Flips: full skin RED (g car row), rest skin on walkers RED (g walker row), fixed 0.18 m RED (e row). Alternative not taken: keep (c) scoped to its approach (acceptance wants city-wide).

Implementer stage end: PARTIAL hand-back. Green on Windows except the Windows-only latent pass contact traffic_go_around::avenue_seed_2; all touched city gates green on Linux. Classes E (G4 seed 7, R1 seed 7) and D (R1 seed 1) and the G4 extra slow-turnover row stay ignored with named reasons for an orchestrator decision; runtime R1 deferred. Alternative not taken: build the U-turn fallback or patch the TASK-032 pass law without a decision.

Item (4) heading cap proposed as a symmetric body-reach band: yaw error capped at asin(m/|half|)-atan2(hx,hz), m = room from the lateral (look-ahead by the yaw turn-back time) to the lane/claim band edges; the connector slide is its cap-0 case. Alternative not taken: a slide-only merge on lanes (cap 0 everywhere), which crabs every lane pass and is more owner-visible than needed.

around_cars reached-corner fix (b) does not resolve a near diagonal target (driver door from the passenger side, target just past the car): the walker dithers 0.5 m off corner A because via(A) counts a blocked A->to line; replica shows old stalls at A, new dithers.

m1 as prescribed (a resting vehicle only if (b.velocity - v)·(centre - rect.centre) <= 0) turned traffic_recovery::g_car_at_rest_inside_the_skin_lets_it_recover RED: the switched car's own velocity noise (1e-7 m/s) makes the dot +1e-14 on 184 of 709 samples, so the sleeping parked car flips out of the rest skin and calm resets.

m1 fixed by sweeping each resting vehicle by its own velocity over recover.horizon_seconds in the corridor's rest-skin check (continuous, no classification flip); nobody_coming already sweeps relative motion. Own velocity left out: after recovery the car moves by the rejoin law, which the rest skin already counts. Alternative not taken: the not-closing sign test with a noise tolerance (a new number).

M1: around_cars scores a corner by the shortest way round the car (straight to the target if the corner sees it, else via the adjacent corner that does, else the far corner), keeping the reached radius. Stateless, so no per-tick flip and no per-walker memory. Alternative not taken: remember the current corner per walker/cop (new state on two FSMs).

C1 heading cap: room taken at the worse of the current offset and the look-ahead offset per band edge; the review's look-ahead alone relaxes the edge the car moves away from while the yaw still grows. Cap applied on lanes only; the connector rejoin keeps its slide. Alternative not taken: cap 0 everywhere (every lane pass crabs).

M2: plain cars skip OnPathTraffic except cars held on a connector without grant or whole box (the drive.rs held predicate, extracted as held_in_box), in both the lane strip and the connector sweep; passable() already refuses OnPathTraffic hits, so no pass is planned on them. Alternative not taken: connector arm only (a granted car entering the box at turn_speed would see the held car only from s 0).

Un-ignored traffic_causes::r1_car_left_in_the_box_seed_7 and traffic_junction_box::seed_1_car_behind_the_body_leaves_liveness: after the fixer round both are green on Windows and Linux (R1 seed 7 worst 23.6 s / 20.2 s, extra row 30.8 s, G1 0), each with a mechanism flip (around_cars straight metric -> R1 seed 7 RED 105.8 s; held-car skip -> extra row RED 55.2 s). G4 seed 7 liveness (class E, 61.3 s) and R1 seed 1 (class D, 113 s) stay ignored for TASK-039. Alternative not taken: keep them ignored as the orchestrator note said (it was written while they were red).

R1 runtime: control_1 marked invalid (the scripted 'drive on' failed; the player rammed the east approach queue for ~18 s and left the car at (12.5,-81.0) at the box entry, as TASK-032's invalid_branch_fix2_control_car_near_box) and rerun; spot A extended to 5 runs because runs 1-2 split (1 vs 3 cars over 30 s) and the goal is a median. Alternative not taken: count control_1 as the control (its placement is not the control scene).

Tourist box bump, isolation by moving the player's car 200 m away (ISOLATE=1): the player (in the car) left view, so the bumped car in the box was despawned by the bubble before the watch started; run kept as invalid. A reverse-out variant (first run) left the player's car at the east box entry against the approach head and the bumped car was 'lost' (> 60 deg / 4 m) and abandoned at the exit mouth, so it measured two stacked obstacles, not the bumped car. Valid run: exit in place and despawn the player's car by BRP (ISOLATE=2), bump at +3 m/s.

Walkers stalled 70-118 s at a car parked on the spot-B crosswalk (runtime B: 6-9 walkers up to 103/150 s; headless probe: 11-13 walkers, clusters of capsules touching at 0.60 m, 0.1-1.3 m from the car) classed as a pre-existing class not closed by the Q1 fold-in (main B runtime: 10-17 walkers up to 153 s), routed to TASK-036, not a SHIP blocker under the orchestrator's 'no new freeze class' rule. Alternative not taken: NEEDS_FIXES on it (the traffic acceptance holds and no AC gates walker stands at B).
